result.title: Compositional Conformal Risk Control for Multi-Stage LLM Cascades
result.summary: Multi-stage large language model (LLM) cascades balance accuracy and inference cost, but reliable deployment also requires controlling error risk and identifying its sources across stages. We propose Compositional Conformal Risk Control (CompCRC), a risk-control framework for pre-specified multi-stage LLM cascades. We decompose the risk of accepting incorrect answers into additive stage-wise contributions over the full query population, linking local risk budgets to a system-level guarantee. CompCRC constructs and freezes candidate budget allocations and acceptance thresholds, selects one candidate on independent data, and certifies its stage-wise risk contributions on separate held-out data. Under conditional exchangeability, we establish a finite-sample guarantee: the marginal expected accepted-error risk of the complete deployment procedure does not exceed the global risk budget. At the reported comparison budget of $α=0.45$, all three stages of CompCRC pass their local checks on MMLU, GSM8K, and HellaSwag. Compared with Global-CRC, which passes system-level risk certification at the same budget, CompCRC reduces observed accepted-error risk by 1.33--2.00 percentage points, improves final accuracy by 0.67--2.00 percentage points, and reduces weighted inference cost by 30.37\% on HellaSwag. The selected cost-based budget allocation also improves accuracy per unit cost by 10.6\%--46.7\% over uniform allocation. Further experiments show that stage-wise statistics identify stages that fail local certification checks, providing diagnostic information alongside system-level risk control.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CompCRC，将多阶段 LLM 级联中「接受错误答案」的风险分解为各阶段的加性贡献，通过冻结候选预算分配与接受阈值、独立数据选择并在留出数据上认证，给出有限样本下不超过全局风险预算的保证，并在 MMLU、GSM8K、HellaSwag 上检验各阶段局部认证与成本收益。
AI.relevance_reason: 分阶段风险预算与接受阈值的选择/认证，可为 LVR 中「何时停止并输出答案」的 STOP 决策与各次 look/think 贡献归因提供可核查的校准思路，但其为纯文本级联设定，与视觉证据筛选和 latent 状态的关系需自行判断。
